content.title: About
content.content: Lomi salmon is a ready‑to‑eat product made from salmon fillet marinated in soy sauce, spices, and aromatic herbs. It has a delicate pink hue, a slightly sweet flavor with umami notes and a mild spiciness. The product is vacuum‑packed, preserving freshness and nutritional qualities.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Salmon is one of the most nutrient‑dense fish, rich in omega‑3 fatty acids.
The term “Lomi” comes from Hawaiian and means “softly mixed,” referring to the marinating method.
Vacuum packaging allows storage for up to 12 months at temperatures from –18 °C to +4 °C.
Lomi salmon is commonly used in sushi, rolls, and as a topping for rice or salads.
The marinade typically includes soy sauce, mirin, ginger, garlic, and sometimes a touch of sugar for balance.

items.title: Rich in omega‑3
items.content: Omega‑3 fatty acids support heart health, reduce inflammation, and aid brain function.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Salmon provides complete protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The product contains vitamin B12, niacin, and riboflavin, which are important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Salmon is a source of selenium, phosphorus, and potassium, beneficial for immunity and electrolyte balance.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Most of the fat in salmon is polyunsaturated, making it suitable for low‑saturated‑fat diets.

items.title: Fish allergy
items.content: People allergic to seafood may experience reactions ranging from mild to severe when consuming salmon.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The marinade can be fairly salty; individuals monitoring sodium intake should consider portion size.

items.title: Contamination risk
items.content: Like any fish, salmon may contain trace amounts of heavy metals (mercury, cadmium); moderate consumption is advised.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, keep the product refrigerated and consume within 3‑5 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Lomi salmon can be eaten straight from the package as a snack, added to sushi rolls, salads, rice dishes, or used as a sandwich filling. Letting it reach room temperature before serving enhances its aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the vacuum‑packed product in the refrigerator at +2…+4 °C. Once opened, transfer the remaining portion to an airtight container and consume within 3‑5 days. For long‑term storage, freeze at –18 °C, where it remains good for up to 12 months.
